e.title: IBLM (Interpretable Boosted Linear Models)
e.summary: 可解释提升线性模型（IFoA-ADSWP 官方，CRAN 1.0.2 + PyPI 2.0.2）：GLM 透明性 + XGBoost 预测力的混合建模 + SHAP 可解释性
e.summary_en: Interpretable Boosted Linear Models (IFoA-ADSWP official, CRAN 1.0.2 + PyPI 2.0.2): hybrid of GLM transparency + XGBoost predictive power with SHAP interpretability
e.summary_hk: 可解釋提升線性模型（IFoA-ADSWP 官方，CRAN 1.0.2 + PyPI 2.0.2）：GLM 透明性 + XGBoost 預測力的混合建模 + SHAP 可解釋性
e.body:
IBLM/pyIBLM（IFoA-ADSWP 官方，R 版 CRAN 1.0.2 + Python 版 PyPI 2.0.2，MIT）实现可解释提升线性模型：结合 GLM 的透明性与梯度提升的预测力——GLM + XGBoost 集成，带 SHAP 可解释性分析与可视化。对 RIAA：精算定价的可解释 ML 官方方法——[[insurance-distill]]（GBM→GLM 蒸馏）的可解释集成替代；「GLM 透明 + 提升预测」正是精算定价的平衡（[[explain-ml-pricing]] 可解释性议题）；IFoA 官方工作组出品（[[ifoa-tabular-foundation-model]] 同组织）；与 [[shap-relativities]]（SHAP 相对数）、[[insurance-gam]]（可解释模型）配套；适合定价建模与可解释 ML 方向。

## 同类工具
[[ibm-dppm]]、[[ibmpopsim]]、[[insurance-counterfactual-sets]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
IBLM/pyIBLM (IFoA-ADSWP official, R CRAN 1.0.2 + Python PyPI 2.0.2, MIT) implements Interpretable Boosted Linear Models: combining the transparency of GLMs with the predictive power of gradient boosting — a GLM + XGBoost ensemble with SHAP-based interpretability analysis and visualisation. For RIAA: the official interpretable-ML method for actuarial pricing — the interpretable-ensemble alternative of [[insurance-distill]] (GBM-to-GLM distillation); 'GLM transparency + boosting power' is exactly the actuarial pricing balance (the [[explain-ml-pricing]] explainability agenda); from the IFoA official working party (same org as [[ifoa-tabular-foundation-model]]); pairs with [[shap-relativities]] (SHAP relativities) and [[insurance-gam]] (interpretable models); suits pricing modelling and explainable ML.

## Similar tools
[[ibm-dppm]]、[[ibmpopsim]]、[[insurance-counterfactual-sets]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
